payload.title: Qwen3.5 GDN Prefill Kernel Optimization on SM100
payload.summary: Practical optimization of Qwen3.5 GDN prefill kernels using Gluon on Blackwell, covering TMA pipelining, async scatter, bitmask causal masking, and zero-copy transpose.

sections.heading: 1. Algorithm Overview
sections.gist: Qwen3.5 GDN prefill uses a chunk-wise algorithm: sequence length T is divided into ⌈T/C⌉ chunks (C=64).

sections.heading: 3. Blackwell Feature Overview
sections.gist: - **TMEM**: 128 rows × 512 cols × 32 bit = **256 KB / CTA**, serves directly as tcgen05_mma output accumulator, eliminating the Hopper WGMMA register accumulator bottleneck - **tcgen05_mma**: Inputs from SMEM/TMEM, output to TMEM, throughp…

sections.heading: 4. chunk_delta_h: Recurrence + Pipelining
sections.gist: Each chunk update has 4 steps: (1) store h_t → (2) v_new = v - w @ h_t → (3) apply gate (v_new *= exp(g_last-g), h *= exp(g_last)) → (4) h_{t+1} = h_t + k^T @ v_new.

sections.heading: 5. Varlen async_scatter (Key Optimization)
sections.gist: `tma.async_copy_shared_to_global` writes in fixed blocks, which can overwrite the next sequence.

sections.heading: 6. chunk_o: Bitmask Causal Mask
sections.gist: Original approach: BT×BT element-wise comparison + where, producing many setp instructions.

sections.heading: 7. Transposed State Zero-Copy
sections.gist: GDN hidden state `[N,H,K,V]` requires `[N,H,V,K]` (K-dimension contiguous) for the decode CuTeDSL kernel.

sections.heading: 8. cumsum Vectorization
sections.gist: The original `chunk_local_cumsum_scalar_kernel` processes only 1 head per chunk per block, with uncoalesced memory access.

sections.heading: 9. Notes
sections.gist: - chunk_size=64 aligns well with Hopper MMA performance; Blackwell theoretically allows tuning but this PR maintains consistency - Only supports sm100
